sonota:wr:9.hint: つらい経験や病気などを乗り越えて元通りになる、という意味の表現です。
sonota:wr:9.answer: It took him months to get over the loss of his dog.
sonota:wr:9.fullSentence: It took him months to get over the loss of his dog.
sonota:wr:9.explanation: get over ~ = overcome(~を克服する)。自動詞+前置詞なので、代名詞が来ても分離しない(get over it)。
sonota:wr:9.relatedInfo: overcomeは他動詞1語で言い換えられる(overcome the loss)。

sonota:wr:10.hint: ある人を立派だと思い、尊敬のまなざしで見る、という意味の表現です。
sonota:wr:10.answer: Many young players look up to that veteran coach.
sonota:wr:10.fullSentence: Many young players look up to that veteran coach.
sonota:wr:10.explanation: look up to ~ = respect(~を尊敬する)。反対はlook down on。
sonota:wr:10.relatedInfo: respectは1語で「尊敬する」という意味の他動詞。

sonota:wr:11.hint: 相手が気づいていない間違いや事実をはっきり示して伝える、という意味の表現です。
sonota:wr:11.answer: The teacher kindly pointed out the mistake in my essay.
sonota:wr:11.fullSentence: The teacher kindly pointed out the mistake in my essay.
sonota:wr:11.explanation: point out ~ (~を指摘する)。誤りや事実を明確に示す時に使う。
sonota:wr:11.relatedInfo: be pointed out (his mistake was pointed out)のように受け身でもよく使われる。

sonota:wr:12.hint: 意見や案などを人々の前に示して提案する、という意味の表現です。
sonota:wr:12.answer: The committee decided to put forward a new proposal.
sonota:wr:12.fullSentence: The committee decided to put forward a new proposal.
sonota:wr:12.explanation: put O forward = put forward O(~を提案する)。目的語の位置は前後どちらでもよい。

sonota:wr:13.hint: あるものを別のものであるとみなして表現する、という意味の文型です。
sonota:wr:13.answer: Critics described it as a masterpiece.
sonota:wr:13.fullSentence: Critics described it as a masterpiece.
sonota:wr:13.explanation: describe A as B(AをBと表現する/みなす)。call A B, define A as Bと似た構造。
sonota:wr:13.relatedInfo: call A B (asなし)との違いに注意。describeは必ずasを伴う。

sonota:wr:14.hint: あるものを別のものにくっつけて取り付ける、という意味の構文です。
sonota:wr:14.answer: Please attach the file to your email before sending it.
sonota:wr:14.fullSentence: Please attach the file to your email before sending it.
sonota:wr:14.explanation: attach A to B(AをBに取り付ける)。比喩的に「愛着を持つ」の意味でも使われる(be attached to)。
sonota:wr:14.relatedInfo: be attached to ~ で「~に愛着がある」という意味になる。

sonota:wr:15.hint: 相手にある情報や事実を知らせる、という意味の構文です。
sonota:wr:15.answer: The manager informed the staff of the schedule change.
sonota:wr:15.fullSentence: The manager informed the staff of the schedule change.
sonota:wr:15.explanation: inform A of B(AにBを知らせる)。convey, notifyも似た構造をとる。
sonota:wr:15.relatedInfo: notify A of Bも同じ意味・形で使われる。

sonota:wr:16.hint: 世間で広くそう言われている、という噂や評判を表す構文です。
sonota:wr:16.answer: This restaurant is said to be the oldest one in the city.
sonota:wr:16.fullSentence: This restaurant is said to be the oldest one in the city.
sonota:wr:16.explanation: It is said that S is C = S is said to be C(~と言われている)。believe, think, knowも同じ構造をとる。
sonota:wr:16.relatedInfo: It is believed that ~ / S is believed to be ~ も同じパターン。

sonota:wr:17.hint: ある人やものを、実際にそうであると考える、という意味の構文です。
sonota:wr:17.answer: Everyone believed him to be the most honest person in town.
sonota:wr:17.fullSentence: Everyone believed him to be the most honest person in town.
sonota:wr:17.explanation: believe/consider/find/prove O to be C(OをCだと思う/証明する)。that節に書き換え可能。
sonota:wr:17.relatedInfo: Everyone believed that he was ~ とthat節でも同じ意味を表せる。

sonota:wr:18.hint: 一方が変化するにつれて、もう一方も同じように変化していく、という意味の構文です。
sonota:wr:18.answer: The harder you try, the more you improve.
sonota:wr:18.fullSentence: The harder you try, the more you improve.
sonota:wr:18.explanation: The 比較級 SV, the 比較級 SV(~すればするほど…)。2つの比較級を対応させる。
sonota:wr:18.relatedInfo: The more, the better.(多ければ多いほど良い)のように短縮した形もよく使われる。

sonota:wr:19.hint: 良い結果になった理由を述べるときに使う、前置詞的な表現です。
sonota:wr:19.answer: Thanks to the new highway, the trip now takes only an hour.
sonota:wr:19.fullSentence: Thanks to the new highway, the trip now takes only an hour.
sonota:wr:19.explanation: thanks to = because of = owing to = due to = by virtue of = on account of(~のおかげで)。
sonota:wr:19.relatedInfo: thanks toは良い結果に、because ofは中立的に使われることが多い。

sonota:wr:20.hint: 2つのものを比べて、その違いを対比的に示すときに使う接続詞です。
sonota:wr:20.answer: City life is fast-paced, whereas country life is calm and slow.
sonota:wr:20.fullSentence: City life is fast-paced, whereas country life is calm and slow.
sonota:wr:20.explanation: while = whereas(一方で)。2つの事柄を対比するときに使う。
sonota:wr:20.relatedInfo: whileは「~している間」という時間の意味でも使われるので文脈に注意。

sonota:wr:21.hint: 一般的な予想や期待とは反対の内容を述べるときに使う前置詞句です。
sonota:wr:21.answer: Contrary to popular belief, the plan actually worked well.
sonota:wr:21.fullSentence: Contrary to popular belief, the plan actually worked well.
sonota:wr:21.explanation: contrary to ~ (~とは反対に)。予想や期待に反する事実を導入する。
sonota:wr:21.relatedInfo: in contrast to ~ も似た意味だが対比のニュアンスが強い。

sonota:wr:22.hint: ある条件に影響されず、それに関係なく物事が起こることを示す表現です。
sonota:wr:22.answer: Regardless of the weather, the festival will be held as planned.
sonota:wr:22.fullSentence: Regardless of the weather, the festival will be held as planned.
sonota:wr:22.explanation: regardless of = irrespective of(~に関わらず)。後ろには名詞または名詞節が続く。
sonota:wr:22.relatedInfo: no matter what/how ~ もほぼ同じ意味で使える。

sonota:wr:23.hint: ある行動を取る目的を表すときに使う接続詞です。
sonota:wr:23.answer: She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand her.
sonota:wr:23.fullSentence: She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand her.
sonota:wr:23.explanation: so that SV(~するために)。canやwillなどの助動詞を伴うことが多い。
sonota:wr:23.relatedInfo: in order that ~ もほぼ同じ意味だが、やや硬い表現。

sonota:wr:24.hint: 2つのものを比べたときの違いを示すときに使う前置詞です。
sonota:wr:24.answer: Unlike his brother, Tom has never been interested in sports.
sonota:wr:24.fullSentence: Unlike his brother, Tom has never been interested in sports.
sonota:wr:24.explanation: unlike ~ (~とは違って)。文頭にも文中にも置ける前置詞。
sonota:wr:24.relatedInfo: differently from ~ も似た意味の表現。

sonota:wr:25.hint: ある時点になるまでに、それより前にある動作が完了していることを表す接続詞です。
sonota:wr:25.answer: By the time we arrived, the concert had already started.
sonota:wr:25.fullSentence: By the time we arrived, the concert had already started.
sonota:wr:25.explanation: by the time SV(~するまでには)。主節はしばしば過去完了・未来完了になる。
sonota:wr:25.relatedInfo: untilは「継続」、by the timeは「期限」のニュアンスの違いに注意。

sonota:wr:26.hint: ある出来事が起こった直後に、別の出来事が続けて起こることを表す接続詞です。
sonota:wr:26.answer: Call me as soon as you arrive at the station.
sonota:wr:26.fullSentence: Call me as soon as you arrive at the station.
sonota:wr:26.explanation: as soon as = the moment = directly SV(~するとすぐに)。
sonota:wr:26.relatedInfo: the moment SV、directly SVも同じ意味で使える。

sonota:wr:27.hint: 以前は一度も経験していなかったことを、初めて経験する、という意味の表現です。
sonota:wr:27.answer: I visited Okinawa for the first time last summer.
sonota:wr:27.fullSentence: I visited Okinawa for the first time last summer.
sonota:wr:27.explanation: for the first time(初めて)⇔ at first(最初は)の違いに注意。
sonota:wr:27.relatedInfo: at firstは「初めのうちは(その後変化する)」というニュアンス。

sonota:wr:28.hint: ある出来事が起こった直後にすぐ次の出来事が起こる、という意味の倒置構文です。
sonota:wr:28.answer: No sooner had she arrived than the meeting began.
sonota:wr:28.fullSentence: No sooner had she arrived than the meeting began.
sonota:wr:28.explanation: No sooner had S Vpp than SV = Hardly had S Vpp when SV(~するとすぐに…した)。否定語が文頭に来ると倒置が起こる。
sonota:wr:28.relatedInfo: Hardly had she arrived when the meeting began. も同じ意味。

sonota:wr:29.hint: 今この瞬間、まさに現在という時を強調する表現です。
sonota:wr:29.answer: I can't talk right now; I'm in a meeting.
sonota:wr:29.fullSentence: I can't talk right now; I'm in a meeting.
sonota:wr:29.explanation: right now = just now(たった今)。ただしjust nowは過去形の文でも使われる点に注意。
sonota:wr:29.relatedInfo: just nowは過去の出来事「ついさっき」の意味でも使われる。

sonota:wr:30.hint: 重要な出来事や変化が、近い将来に起こりそうだ、という意味の表現です。
sonota:wr:30.answer: A major change in the industry is on the horizon.
sonota:wr:30.fullSentence: A major change in the industry is on the horizon.
sonota:wr:30.explanation: be on the horizon(間近に迫っている)。将来起こりそうな出来事を暗示する表現。
sonota:wr:30.relatedInfo: be around the corner も似た意味で使われる。

sonota:wr:31.hint: 正確な数はわからないが、とても多くの人や物があることを表す数量表現です。
sonota:wr:31.answer: Millions of people watched the final match on TV.
sonota:wr:31.fullSentence: Millions of people watched the final match on TV.
sonota:wr:31.explanation: millions of = thousands of = hundreds of = dozens of(何百万/何千/何百/数十もの)。
sonota:wr:31.relatedInfo: 複数形のsを忘れないこと(million of Xとは言わない)。

sonota:wr:32.hint: グループの中の一人一人に注目して述べるときに使う数量表現です。
sonota:wr:32.answer: Each of the members was asked to give a short speech.
sonota:wr:32.fullSentence: Each of the members was asked to give a short speech.
sonota:wr:32.explanation: all of / each of / every / any of(すべての/それぞれの/いずれかの)。each ofは単数扱い。
sonota:wr:32.relatedInfo: each ofの後の動詞は単数形になる点に注意(was, not were)。

sonota:wr:33.hint: 数えられない名詞について、量がとても少ないことを表す形容詞です。
sonota:wr:33.answer: There is little water left in the bottle.
sonota:wr:33.fullSentence: There is little water left in the bottle.
sonota:wr:33.explanation: few ⇔ little(数えられる名詞/数えられない名詞の「少ない」)。
sonota:wr:33.relatedInfo: fewは可算名詞、littleは不可算名詞に使う点が最大の違い。
